notes.title: What’s next for Survivor TD: Favors of the Gods ?
notes.content:
[h3]ːsteamthumbsupː A sandbox-style demo… by design[/h3][p]The current demo was built as a [b]sandbox-style experience[/b], with [b]minimal restrictions[/b].[/p][p]You could:[/p][list][*][p]Progress very quickly,[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock powerful meta-upgrades,[/p][/*][*][p]Feel a glimpse of what [i]endgame power[/i] might look like.[/p][/*][/list][p]This made it [b]fun to experiment[/b] and [b]easy to get hooked [/b]- a lot of players played more than 30 minutes.
But it also came [b]at the cost of challenge and strategy[/b] - especially for a game inspired by [b]tower defense principles[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Where the game is going[/h3][p]Moving forward, the next update will focus more on [b]tactical choices and strategic depth[/b]. Here's what's coming:[/p][p]🔒 [b]New limitations[/b] on towers availability > encouraging smart planning rather than brute force. 
🏹 [b]Better control over enemy waves[/b] > so you can influence their path more meaningfully.
🛒 [b]Reworked meta-progression[/b] > so long-term upgrades don’t overwhelm core skill expression.

The demo is updated frequently with new ideas.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Why it matters[/h3][p][i]Survivor TD[/i] isn't just about surviving - it's about [b]crafting your own maze[/b], controlling chaos, and building a [b]powerful toolkit[/b] that feels earned.[/p][p]Expect future versions to [b]lean more into tower defense mechanics[/b], while keeping the accessible fun that made the demo engaging.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for playing and wishlist-ing!
This project is still solo-dev powered, and your support makes a huge difference ːsteamthisː[/p][p]ːsteamhappyː [b]If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game![/b][/p][p]_ Cartable Studio[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update – Feedback Improvements!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback — I’ve made some key changes to the demo based on your suggestions:
[/p][list][*][p]Added glowing indicators for key buttons during the tutorial to improve UI readability and controls tooltips. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the early waves to allow a smoother progression and more time to discover game mechanics and powers.
[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the drop rate of health packs from monsters.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Health packs are those tiny flames, if you were wondering [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656753/e9ccdfdbdf3e2ab829b12bc4781a339207f59115.png"][/img]More updates are coming soon. Your feedback is super valuable, and I’m working hard to deliver the best version possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for the support 🙏[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656753/561b4740a034c8f3289e90c6b6f9e56d434b8246.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656753/739fa0e8426c2b05c14955dc866755b01949e63a.png"][/img][/p]
